Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.

The UNIVPM equipment guideline states that the manufacturer is obliged to supply the instructions for use on paper. On 1 March 2027, for a machine intended only for professional users and placed on the market that day, may the manufacturer provide the instructions for use in digital format instead of on paper?

response.text: According to the UNIVPM equipment guideline, the manufacturer must supply the instructions for use on paper. For a machine intended solely for professional users and placed on the market on 1 March 2027, is the manufacturer permitted to supply those instructions in digital format rather than on paper?
